name: cand-plan-init-reopen
title: Add gated PLAN->INIT reopen so a scope-flagged frozen title on a worktree story can be fixed
description: Bounce recovery for worktree stories is broken two ways: dev_start false-fails from inside the worktree (storyRel/reuse-check resolve against the main repo root while the metadata root is the worktree, yielding a .worktrees/<id>/-prefixed branch path), and the state machine has no backward edge out of PLAN toward INIT_CHECK/INIT. Add a gated PLAN->INIT reopen transition (title/context are editable only at INIT), fix the dev_start worktree-reuse path so re-advance INIT->INIT_CHECK reuses the existing worktree, correct the contradictory checklist guidance, and add a round-trip smoke that reopens->edits a title->re-reviews->re-advances entirely from inside the worktree with no manual git surgery.
